title: Time bound for prefix emission
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, the finite Turing machine that emits $w$ and then copies its input computes the function $x\mapsto w\mathbin{++}x$ in time $|w|+|x|+1$, where $|\cdot|$ denotes word length. Here computing in time means that the machine halts after that many steps with the stated output, for some amount of work-tape space.
hypotheses_covered: the input ranges over all Boolean words
